create_parse_mmcif: parse an mmCIF file and return a MmcifObject with structure, sequences, and metadata
parse_mmcif_string: parse an mmCIF string by file id and return a ParsingResult with MmcifObject and errors
filter_mmcif_object: filter an MmcifObject by removing specified atoms, residues, and chains from the structure
extract_mmcif_loop: extract mmCIF loop data by prefix from parsed info as a list of dictionaries
apply_assembly_transformations: apply crystallographic assembly transformations to a Biomolecule using rotation and translation matrices
